Plot a de-chirped scalogram

Source: R/analyse_dechirped.R
plot_dechirped.Rd

Plot a de-chirped scalogram

Usage

plot_dechirped(
  x,
  style = c("outline", "significance", "plain", "tuned"),
  show = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  palette = "viridis",
  main = NULL,
  xlab = "Depth",
  ylab = "Period",
  scale = "auto",
  outline_lwd = 0.6
)

Arguments

x

Result of analyse_dechirped (list of class wr_dechirped). Required, no default.

style

What to draw (character), one of:

  • "outline": the de-chirped depth map with the cells that are significant against the warped surrogates outlined in white (needs n_sim > 0 in analyse_dechirped);

  • "significance": the ratio to the 95th percentile of the warped surrogates (log10, diverging colour scale; needs n_sim > 0);

  • "plain": the de-chirped depth map;

  • "tuned": the transform in the time of the track (periods in kyr).

Without surrogates "outline" and "significance" fall back to "plain" with a message. Default="outline" (the first element of c("outline", "significance", "plain", "tuned")).

show

Astronomical periods in kyr to draw as dotted lines (numeric vector, e.g. c(405, 100, 41)): in the depth styles at the period they have at the tracked rate (period x local rate), in the "tuned" style as horizontal lines. NULL draws none. Default=NULL.

level

Significance level of the outline (numeric, between 0 and 1): cells with a p-value of at most 1 - level are outlined. Only used when style="outline". Default=0.95.

palette

Name of a hcl.colors palette for the colour scale, a character string, for example "viridis", "Plasma", "Inferno", "YlOrRd", "Spectral", "Blue-Red", "Zissou 1"; run grDevices::hcl.pals() to list all 115 names. Low values get the first colour of the palette. Names of the viridis family ("viridis", "magma", "inferno", "plasma", "cividis", "rocket", "mako", "turbo") give the colours of the viridis package, as in the wavelet plots. Default="viridis".

main

Title of the plot (character string); NULL gives an automatic title that names the transform and the style. Default=NULL.

xlab, ylab

Labels of the depth and period axes (character strings) of the depth styles; the "tuned" style always uses "Time of the track (kyr)" and "Period (kyr)". Defaults: xlab: Default="Depth"; ylab: Default="Period".

scale

Colour scale as in all image plots of the package (character): "auto", "log", "quantile", "sqrt" or "linear" (see plot_wavelet). The significance style always uses a fixed diverging scale centred on the 95th percentile of the surrogates. Default="auto".

outline_lwd

Line width of the significance outline (numeric, > 0). Default=0.6.

Value

Invisibly, the matrix shown.
